settings.intro: Quick answers to the things people ask us most.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We currently ship to the USA and the Philippines.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Shipping options and delivery times are shown at checkout. You'll get a tracking link by email once your order ships.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Use the tracking link in your shipping email, or log in to your account to see your orders.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: If something isn't right, email support@pickora.com and we'll help with a return or refund. Our full refund policy is linked in the footer.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: Email support@pickora.com, Mon–Fri 9am–6pm. We usually reply within a day.
